max-inline-size.comment: A raw dimension on purpose, following modal.width-*. A popover width has no semantic ancestor in tier 2 size, and inventing one would put a popover-shaped value in the public layer.

fg.comment: The panel PORTALS to document.body, so it does not inherit text colour from where it was written - and `[data-clara-theme]` redefines custom properties only, it declares no `color`. With no declaration the text colour came from the PAGE while the background came from the portal scope, so a dark-theme panel rendered near-black text on a dark surface: measured 1.26:1 in Chromium, against 16.64:1 for the overlays that declare it. Modal, Tooltip, Toast and DropdownMenu all declare colour; these two did not.
